description: Maps keywords, file patterns, and paths to relevant skills for auto-activation. The 'paths' field aligns with SKILL.md frontmatter 'paths' for cross-tool compatibility.

rules.message: Use `us scaffold app` to create new apps. Do not manually create project files.
This is a desktop app. Consider /setup-pear-desktop for Pear desktop setup.
This looks like a terminal/service app. Consider /setup-pear-terminal for a headless Pear app.
This is a mobile app. Consider /setup-mobile-app for Expo + Bare setup.
This is a Node.js CLI app. Consider /setup-node-cli for customization patterns.
Use /add-p2p-networking for Unstoppable P2P sessions, pairing and API selection.
Use /add-p2p-rpc for typed @unstoppable-stack/p2p/rpc procedures and /service sessions.
This involves exposing a capability to other apps. Consider /add-node-capability for capability packs and pairing codes.
Use /add-p2p-sync for managed JSON data or /sync resource mirroring.
This needs multi-writer sync. Consider /add-multi-writer-sync for managed collaborative JSON or the existing schema-based store.
Use /add-encrypted-channels for encrypted P2P transport with pairing and grants.
Use /add-kv-storage for managed shared JSON while preserving private local stores.
Use /add-database to choose managed collaboration or preserve an existing schema store.
Use /add-file-storage for app-owned drives with P2P sync resource manifests.
This involves AI inference. Consider /add-ai-chat for QVAC chat and tool calling.
This involves image analysis. Consider /add-ai-vision for QVAC multimodal vision.
This involves audio transcription. Consider /add-ai-transcription for QVAC Whisper.
This involves RAG/search. Consider /add-ai-rag for QVAC workspace-based embeddings (ragIngest/ragSearch).
This involves exposing QVAC over HTTP. Consider /add-openai-server for the OpenAI-compatible local server.
This involves text-to-image generation. Consider /add-ai-image-gen for QVAC's diffusion plugin.
This involves writing a QVAC plugin. Consider /add-ai-plugin for definePlugin/defineHandler patterns.
This involves applying a LoRA adapter. Consider /add-ai-finetune for adapter-based specialization.
This involves payments/wallet. Consider /add-wallet for WDK patterns.
This involves P2P testing. Consider /setup-local-testing for local DHT bootstrap.
